skill.summary: Write heartfelt and professional thank you notes for any occasion. Perfect for showing gratitude after interviews, gifts, help, or acts of kindness.

latestVersion.changelog:
Thank You Note Generator v1.0.1

- Added sample thank you templates for job interviews, gifts, help, and business partnerships.
- Introduced options for tone (formal, casual, warm) and length (quick notes to detailed letters).
- Included quick templates for text messages and social media comments.
- Provided practical tips for writing effective thank you notes.
- Emphasized personalizing notes with specific details and timely delivery.
